name: @local/dsh-danbooru-tools
description: DSH bundle (not a standalone program) — AI-made, read-only, image-only Danbooru tools (15 tools): post/tag search, tag details and wiki, related tags; year-favorites artist ranking with body-shape gate + skin/color references; Hot/rising weighted sampling; similar artists (tag + expression profiles); layered image-to-artist search; style-first tag matching with small-artist discovery, seed_artists and rejection memory; PIXEL-SIMILARITY style matching (downloads reference + candidate images and compares line/shading/palette/hue descriptors, so identity tags cannot drive it); multi-scheme consensus; body-part specialists. Pixel mode needs Python with Pillow.
